items.title: Decathlon fails to refund shoe buyer, ordered to pay Rs 20,067 by consumer court
items.author: SAURABH THAKUR
items.description: A consumer court in Himachal Pradesh has ordered Decathlon Sports India to issue a refund of Rs 10,067 to a customer named Akshay Thakur. Thakur alleged that he did not receive the refund for his canceled orders, while Decathlon insisted the refund was processed. However, the court determined that the company failed to provide evidence of the transaction, leading to additional compensation and litigation costs against Decathlon.
